issue_request: FHIR-23847 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to add an IEEE 11073 20601 Optimized Exchange Protocol to Device mapping table from an attached markdown proposal.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly referencing FHIR-23847 or 11073-20601 was found. 2022 DEV minutes treated the issue as stale and questioned whether the approved attachment was still relevant and actually applied.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. Current mappingSpaces.xml and Device StructureDefinition source publish and use ACOM, DIM, and BICEPS mappings for ISO/IEEE 11073-10206, 11073-10201, and 11073-10207. Later Applied issue FHIR-51425 approved three Device 11073 mapping sets after PHD/PoCD review and is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding a separate legacy 11073-20601 table from the inaccessible 2019 attachment would duplicate or conflict with the later ACOM/DIM/BICEPS mapping-space model without a current work-group decision.
